correctness.rationale: For square-zero N, AB=BC=0 and AE+DC=0 are exhaustive. Fixing rank t of B yields rank-r A matrices factoring through a (b-t)-space and rank-s C maps into a (c-t)-space. The linear equation has codimension as+rd-rs among (D,E), by independent image-sum and intersection dimensions. Multiplying exact matrix-rank counts and free F choices proves the formula for every finite field. The standalone checker exhaustively validates every coefficient for 11 configurations and tests 196 rank identities, without claiming infinite proof from finite checks.

originality.rationale: The proposed novelty is only the fully joint adjacent-block rank polynomial. Bardestani et al. Theorem 2.5 already counts rank(N) for square-zero elements of arbitrary parabolic nilradicals, and Karp--Thomas Theorem 5.13 already enumerates ambient and fixed-flag Jordan types. Explicit four-level matrices with the same prefix Jordan types but different adjacent rank profiles show those statistics do not logically determine the present three-variable distribution. No corresponding exact joint formula was found in inspected sources or published-finding corpus records. Residual priority risk: an uninspected refined parabolic/quiver count may exist.
residual_risks: Equivalent parabolic or quiver representation rank-profile formula may be in a specialist source not located in inspected searches.

value.rationale: An intrinsic adjacent-layer rank profile on a square-zero incidence-radical locus distinguishes elements which ordinary and fixed-flag Jordan distributions cannot distinguish. Its all-field exact multivariate census is a natural geometric stratification across an infinite class of four-level posets, motivated by known coarse parabolic/Jordan enumeration. It gives exact sizes of the strata needed for finer orbit and incidence calculations without claiming downstream theorems.
